effect_description_eng: ＜Iceclad＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash any 3 digivolution cards from your opponent's Digimon. Then, if they don't have a Digimon with digivolution cards, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ and can't be deleted other than in battle until their turn ends. (Rule) Trait: Has [Ice-Snow] Type.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. If this effect didn't trash, this [Ice-Snow] trait Digimon may unsuspend.
